'''2008 Match Play Championship Day 2 Jonny Chu LS You Can Either Profit By This...''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Jonny Chu]] at [[2008 Match Play Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS14]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
